summary: Axonex AI Group Limited (formerly Mint Incorporation Limited), a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its July 2, 2026 securities purchase agreements and Amendment No. 1 to its July 30, 2026 agreements, extending the deadline for filing an F-3/F-1 resale registration statement covering previously issued Class A ordinary shares to March 31, 2027, and permitting the statement to cover shares sold to other investors. The filing is a routine contractual amendment and name-change update, not a special situation; no price, premium, or board recommendation is stated. Watch resale-registration timing and share overhang.
